prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Rux Emberchain. Character visual motifs: scarred courier with a giant shoulder mail-satchel of glowing sealed envelopes and iron skate-boots; not a fire-remnant sword ninja.
TOP LEFT: Return Address. Ability concept: attacks place a stamp on enemy champions (1 stamp / enemy / 6 s). Stamps reveal Rux's intended target for 4 s.
TOP RIGHT: Express Mail. Ability concept: throws a volatile letter to an ally, enemy, or ground point. A carrier retains it for up to 3 s; enemies may hand it off to another enemy with a movement interaction to avoid the later blast.
BOTTOM LEFT: Courier's Crossing. Ability concept: draws a short path between Rux and a stamped point. Rux can run it at boosted speed but not dash through collision; crossing a carried letter collects it and produces a radial spark burst.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Dead Letter Office. Ability concept: simultaneously recalls all placed letters **along visible straight routes** toward a central postal seal. Each letter can hit a champion once; safe gaps exist between routes. Enemies can relocate before recall.
